reasons.plausibility: Replacing Hf with V is unlikely to maintain high-temperature strength because V has a much lower melting point and would drastically reduce solidus temperature and creep resistance at 1000 °C, contradicting refractory alloy design principles.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific measurements, a baseline, and quantitative rejection criteria for both density and mechanical properties.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a physically unsound substitution that would almost certainly fail, wasting experimental effort on a fundamentally flawed concept.
